subject.title: Nix: speed up gateway builds and enforce cache-only CI consumers

question: Should maintainers manually close this stale branch as mostly superseded, or sponsor a fresh rebase for the remaining source-builder `mv` optimization?
rationale: Current main already includes the safer pieces and the PR is member-authored and conflicting, so automation should not choose whether to preserve the remaining install-semantic change.

options.title: Close as mostly superseded
options.body: Keep current main's released `dontFixup`, symlink validation, and smoke-check coverage, and drop the stale dirty branch unless the move optimization is re-proposed narrowly.

options.title: Rebase narrowly
options.body: Preserve current installer payload, cleanup, validation, and wrapper defaults, then apply only the still-wanted move optimization with fresh gateway checks.

recommendation.title: Close as mostly superseded
recommendation.body: Keep current main's released `dontFixup`, symlink validation, and smoke-check coverage, and drop the stale dirty branch unless the move optimization is re-proposed narrowly.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the trim commit and recent overlapping gateway packaging changes, making them the best available owner for the rebase-or-close choice.
